acceptanceCriteria: a read-only finding lists OPEN tickets whose cited requirement IDs or ticket IDs appear in merged first-parent commits, naming the commit
no finding for tickets without such evidence; abstains when history is unavailable
body: Observed 2026-10-19: V1-1192 and V1-1194 stayed OPEN although their requirements landed on main in PR #1060 (b9cfe9618); V1-1879 stayed OPEN after #1176 merged. Finding them took manual git log -S and grep. A doctor/audit finding that links ticket requirement IDs or 'GH #N' titles to merged commits on the default branch would surface delivered-but-open work for closeout.
title: Tasks: report OPEN tickets whose delivering change already merged (delivered-but-open audit)
